reason: In app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb:19-22, any upload that isn't API-synchronous runs create_upload inside Scheduler::Defer.later, and lib/scheduler/defer.rb:5,55 serves that one shared Queue from a single thread. The patch adds up to five synchronous ImageMagick downsize passes on images of up to 10MB to that job (uploads_controller.rb:63-70), so a large upload holds up unrelated deferred work.
